name: tmsampark
description: TMSAMPARK legal and business compliance services platform

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @tmsampark/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @tmsampark/api" "npm run dev -w @tmsampark/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @tmsampark/shared && npm run build -w @tmsampark/api && npm run build -w @tmsampark/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @tmsampark/shared && npm run test -w @tmsampark/api && npm run test -w @tmsampark/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @tmsampark/api && npm run lint -w @tmsampark/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @tmsampark/shared && npm run typecheck -w @tmsampark/api && npm run typecheck -w @tmsampark/web
scripts.seed: npm run build -w @tmsampark/shared && npm run seed -w @tmsampark/api
scripts.create-admin: npm run build -w @tmsampark/shared && npm run create-admin -w @tmsampark/api
